dedupe_keys.name: argentina official register of educational establishments padron oficial de establecimientos educativos

description: The Padrón Oficial de Establecimientos Educativos is Argentina's unified list of schools and other educational establishments with their active education offers, kept up to date continuously by the education statistics units of each jurisdiction through an online system and published by the national Secretaría de Educación. The June 2026 file has one sheet of about 64,700 rows; its columns include jurisdiction, public or private sector, urban or rural setting, department and locality with their codes, the establishment and location code (Cueanexo), name, street address, postcode, telephone and email, and flags for each offer from early childhood and primary to secondary, higher non-university, vocational training, adult, special and hospital education. Coverage: all provinces and the City of Buenos Aires. Access: one XLSX per year from 2011 to 2025 plus a file to June 2026 on the national open data portal, with the CKAN API. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: there are no coordinates, so mapping needs geocoding of addresses or a join to another layer; one building can host several establishments and one establishment several annexes; the contact fields contain personal emails for some schools. Simulation uses are an inventory of schools as critical facilities and shelters for exposure, emergency planning and education capacity studies. Related records: the Italian school buildings register; the Philippines public school locations; the Giga school connectivity map.
